name: The Blackbird of Amor
source:
When there is an unsolved mystery, Stein can't let it go, he must pursue it till the end. In Amor there is a certain woman that interests him, she is rumored to have eternal youth. To solve the mystery of this woman he must tear heaven from earth. His journey will take him far beyond the world he has known.

[From [url=http://blackbirdoa.com/]Official site[/url]]
translation:
只要遇到未解之謎，斯坦就無法置之不理，非得追查到底不可。在阿莫爾，有一位女子引起了他的興趣：傳聞她擁有永駐的青春。為了揭開她身上的秘密，他不惜撕裂天地。這趟旅程將帶他遠遠超越自己所熟知的世界。

[摘自[url=http://blackbirdoa.com/]Official site[/url]]
